title: Mobile Hailing Technology and Taxi Driving Behaviors
authors: Yanwen Wang; Chunhua Wu; Ting Zhu
main_or_robustness: main (Bayesian joint model of latent app adoption and taxi driving behaviors, with survey-based adoption likelihood)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: MCMC hierarchical model in which adoption is latent and simulated each iteration, with peer adoption ratio and IV-type equation; no TWFE DiD on observed adoption dates

eligible_reason: Not an eligible DiD. Adoption is unobserved and modeled jointly with driving behavior in a Bayesian MCMC model.
design_notes: MATLAB main.m: latent adoption status drawn from adoption probabilities; outcomes modeled by Bayesian regressions with driver and period random effects.
data_files_note: readme: simulation.m generates simulated data for 1,000 drivers x 100 periods.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read; package_mismatch checked against title, authors and README.
